HTTP 队列查询、按下标点赞和按歌曲名删除保持兼容。

-- setup --
POST /music/pick
{
  "source": "wy",
  "id": "http-current",
  "user": {
    "name": "http-user"
  }
}

-- setup --
POST /music/pick
{
  "source": "wy",
  "id": "http-queued",
  "user": {
    "name": "http-user"
  }
}

-- request --
POST /music/playlist
{}

-- response --
200
{
  "playlist": [
    {
      "name": "同名歌曲",
      "artist": "artist",
      "source": "netease",
      "id": "http-queued",
      "likes": 0,
      "user": {
        "name": "http-user",
        "email": ""
      }
    }
  ]
}

-- request --
POST /music/good
{
  "index": 1,
  "name": "同名歌曲"
}

-- response --
200
{
  "name": "同名歌曲",
  "likes": 1
}

-- request --
POST /music/delete
{
  "id": "同名歌曲"
}

-- response --
200
{
  "name": "同名歌曲"
}
